plan.archetype: Frontloaded damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter near full health with damage upgrades, poison scaling, reliable block and a defensive potion. Cross the 160 HP threshold quickly; prepare strong single-card turns for Ringing.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage first, then build poison and dexterity defense. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage. Fight elites with adequate health and potions; balance key upgrades against healing.
